$schema.description: Lets your editor check this file and suggest fields. Leave it as it is.

id.description: Must match the file name: "movies-90s" for movies-90s.json.

name.description: The pack name players see, e.g. "Back to School".

description.description: One or two sentences telling players what is in the pack.

language.description: The language players read the pack in, as a code: "en", "en-NG", "fr", "yo"…

contributors.description: GitHub usernames of the people who wrote the pack, without "@". Add yours.

text.description: What the team has to guess. At most 50 characters.

tags.description: What kind of thing it is, e.g. "snack" or "game". Players can filter by tag.

items.description: Lowercase words joined by hyphens, e.g. "snack" or "tv-show".

modes.description: How it can be clued: "describe", "act" (silently) or "sing" (or hum). Leave it out for describe only.
